# restricted airspace

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayTypeRestrictedAirspace`](gmeow-overlayTypeRestrictedAirspace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayTypeRestrictedAirspace>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

An airspace restriction including prohibited areas, restricted areas, danger areas, temporary reserved airspace (TRA), temporary segregated airspace (TSA), and no-fly zones. 3D bounds (altitude/ flight levels) are carried via [`overlayLowerBound`](../properties/gmeow-overlayLowerBound.md) / [`overlayUpperBound`](../properties/gmeow-overlayUpperBound.md).
